notes: CAP13 inbound kernel from repository substrate: signature-before-dedupe (Slack-style HMAC). Dedupe is an in-memory HashSet, so trusted O3/O4 are forbidden. Google Docs pageToken poller is not claimed as durable poll. Not a domain world model. Do not claim O5.

semantic_contract.canonical_name: Webhook Handler and Google Docs Poller
semantic_contract.user_intent: Accept an authenticated inbound event without reprocessing duplicates.
semantic_contract.state_transition: untrusted payload → verified inbound signal or reject
semantic_contract.persistence_requirement: process-local seen-key set; not a durable UNIQUE store
semantic_contract.tenant_requirement: intended integration binding; durable tenant mapping is not proven here
semantic_contract.visibility_access_semantics: integration-scoped; Debug redacts tokens and file ids
semantic_contract.failure_semantics: signature mismatch and replay window fail closed before dedupe
semantic_contract.idempotency_semantics: duplicate dedup key is ignored in process memory
semantic_contract.concurrency_semantics: in-memory set; not a durable UNIQUE constraint
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: verified events dispatch once per process lifetime; invalid signatures never reach dedupe
semantic_contract.no_ai_behavior: deterministic HMAC and cursor diff; AI not required
semantic_contract.chronica_allowed_divergences: kernel only; no CAP15 WebApp observation adapter and no canonical NewsEvent here
semantic_contract.known_unimplemented_facets: durable dedupe store, durable checkpoint, canonical reconciliation, shipped caller, O3+
